final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT circuitId AS c1, AVG(round) AS c2, COUNT(*) AS c3 FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c3) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT c3 FROM s1 ORDER BY c3 DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.c1, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c3 * 1.0 / s2.t AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 >= (SELECT MIN(c3) FROM s3) ORDER BY ratio DESC
